articles.summary: During our Bedford Employee Appreciation Day, I was reminded that all of those outcomes begin with people. The goal for this year's event was straightforward. We wanted employees to have an opportunity to step away from their daily responsibilities and enjoy being part of the broader Bedford community. While we collaborate every day, we don't always have opportunities to get to know one another beyond projects and meetings.
articles.title: Why Employee Appreciation Matters More Than Ever
